phase3_findings.description: docs/DEVFLOW_SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md:902 — the canonical §17 configuration-reference row for the light command path still read `devflow.effort` / `allowed_tools`. Both halves are dead (devflow.yml:159 reads .prflow.effort, :165 reads .prflow.allowed_tools). The issue's literal `git grep -F 'devflow.allowed_tools'` enumeration structurally could not see it because the table factors the family prefix out of the key name.

The changeset's absolute claim 'Every such instruction now names the live key' was falsified by docs/DEVFLOW_SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md:902 — a self-contradicting diff, and the prose ships verbatim into CHANGELOG.md on merge.

The changeset's 'no error, no breadcrumb' over-stated the silence: it is true only for a consumer whose config already carries a `prflow` family. An un-migrated consumer trips devflow.yml's MISSING_FAMILIES fail-loud guard. Commit 26bfd0aa carried the qualifier; 8ab82769's tightening pass dropped it.

PRE-EXISTING, OUT OF SCOPE: .github/workflows/devflow.yml:925 and :1001 pass `SECTION: devflow` to the provider resolver while the two sibling workflows pass prflow_implement / prflow_runner. The schema declares prflow.provider, so a consumer's provider routing is silently ignored on the whole /prflow:* command path. Verified unchanged on origin/main, so this PR neither introduced it nor made its schema description false (the schema legitimately declares prflow.provider).

PRE-EXISTING, OUT OF SCOPE: a residual `devflow.<other-key>` instruction class remains across the tree — including two emitted runtime remedies (devflow-runner.yml:243 `::error::devflow.allowed_bots is missing`, lib/scan.sh:227 warning), scripts/workpad.py:368's breadcrumb, .prflow/config.schema.json:313/:1136, docs/DEVFLOW_SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md rows 898/900/901/903/904 and :808/:841, and several docs/cloud-setup.md, docs/install.md, docs/review-agent-overrides.md and docs/workflow-triggers.md sites. Outside this issue's `allowed_tools` scope.

PRE-EXISTING, OUT OF SCOPE: lib/test/run.sh:33559-33562's #405 grant loop iterates three of the four heads CLAUDE.md's edited tier-2 bullet names — Bash(lib/test/run-module.sh:*) is absent, so dropping that grant would leave the edited sentence false with a green suite. Also lib/test/run.sh:4058's assertion LABEL still names devflow.allowed_tools while its jq reads .prflow.allowed_tools (AC2 mandates run.sh stay byte-identical, so it is correctly left).
